establishes: prompt and parse viability for A and B and the cost per episode on development episodes; not an A-versus-B result
estimate_basis: dry-run mean attempts per episode x $0.0419 per call (mean of earlier live teaching calls in spend.jsonl); the fixture B stops early, so B's share is a lower bound
note: B-only re-check of the option protocol (B picks among its legal next steps) after two failed B calibrations

stop_conditions.boundary_violation: any information-boundary violation stops the run and is reported
stop_conditions.global_ceiling: SpendGuard stops when the shared spend would pass min(authorized, funded) - reserve
stop_conditions.run_cap: SpendGuard stops the run when the next call's worst case would pass --cap-usd
